documents.title: Shareholder Return Policy | IR | Company - Hyundai Worldwide
paragraphs: Hyundai Motor Company aims to enhance corporate value by implementing and executing shareholder return policy. HMC seeks to continue shareholder return via TPR of 35%+, minimum DPS& quarterly dividends, and share buyback.

documents.title: CEO Letter to Shareholders | Management Information | IR - Hyundai Worldwide
paragraphs: Our commitment to shareholder returns remains unwavering. Our annual dividend for 2025 was KRW 10,000 per share and we will continue to implement a transparent and clear shareholder return policy. We are executing on the targets we communicated, and we will continue to create channels, including new model launch events and our CEO Investor Day, to actively share our vision, performance, and strategy with the investment community.
